newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET BIDDING FOR BIG U.S. DEAL -PAPER.
newsitem.headline: VALMET BIDDING FOR BIG U.S. DEAL -PAPER.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy has made a bid to supply paper machinery to a planned 2.4 billion markka recycled newsprint paper mill to built in New York City, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday.
Valmet had negotiated in New York last week, the paper said and quoted unnamed sources as saying that agreement should be reached in Helsinki on March 6 and 7.
It quoted a Valmet official as saying Valmet had made an offer but was not aware that plans would have advanced that far.
The paper said Valmet's name was already on presentation material for the mill, which it said would be the largest industrial project in New York since World War Two.
